message.content: {"caption":"A three-panel flow diagram contrasts outcome-gated and deployment-feedback skill revision with SelfEvoSkill’s paired-execution approach, which does not require external outcome signals.","description":"The diagram has three rounded panels. The two left panels have orange dashed borders; the right panel has a blue border. In “Outcome-Gated Evolution,” a document labelled “[Skill S]” points downward to “[Agent executes],” then to “[External outcome signal]” (shown with a red exclamation icon and an italic “external signal” tag), then to “[Retain or reject by outcome],” and finally to “[Skill Iterator].” A curved arrow labelled “iterate” runs up the panel’s left side from the iterator toward the skill. The bottom states “requires external outcome signals.” In “Deployment-Feedback Evolution,” “[Skill S]” points down to “[Agent executes],” which has a red exclamation badge, then to a diamond labelled “Fail?” The “No” branch points right to “[No evolution].” The “Yes” branch points down to “[Deployment feedback],” shown with a red exclamation icon and an “external signal” tag; this points down to “[Revision signal from feedback]” and then “[Skill Iterator].” A curved “iterate” arrow runs up the panel’s left side. The bottom states “requires deployment feedback.” In “SelfEvoSkill (Ours),” a box labelled “[Initial Skill S₀ → evolved skill S*]” points down to an exploration stage with two side-by-side executions: “T_w with skill S” and “T_wo without skill,” each shown with a robot icon and a document. The paired executions point down to “[PACE] diagnoses paired execution differences,” marked with a green “GT-FREE” badge. This points down to “[Task-Compiled Verifier] checks explicit task constraints,” then to “[Skill Iterator],” which contains blue “[Refine]” and purple “[Repair]” buttons. A curved arrow labelled “iterate” runs up the left side toward the skill stage. The bottom states “no external outcome signals.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
